title: The construction of $q$-analogues via $_3φ_2$-series and $q$-difference equations
summary: We apply the EKHAD-normalization method given in our recent work to obtain, via the $q$-version of Zeilberger's algorithm, $q$-WZ pairs $(F, G)$ such that $\sum_{k = 0}^{\infty} F(0, k)$ may be expressed as a basic hypergeometric series of the form ${}_{3}φ_2$ with multiple free parameters, and in such a way so that $\sum_{k=0}^{\infty} F(0, k) = \sum_{n=0}^{\infty} G(n, 0)$.
